note: Each sha384 is computed by sev-snp-measure from the recorded inputs below, then confirmed equal to what the hardware reported in a live SNP report. The computation is the source; the hardware reading is only the confirmation, because a measurement read off the machine being attested would certify whatever happened to boot. Reproduce with: sev-snp-measure --mode snp --vcpus=<vcpu_count> --vcpu-type=EPYC-v4 --ovmf=<ovmf> --kernel=<kernel> --append=<cmdline>.
